title: RNA Extraction from Milk for HPAI Surveillance
author: Andrew Lail
materials: Zymo RNA Clean and Concentrator-5 kit

Use the MagMax Wastewater Ultra x96 kit 1 (or comparable magnetic bead isolation kit 2-5 ) on the ThermoFisher Kingfisher Apex (or comparable instrument). For each sample, load 400 uL of pasteurized milk or heavy whipping cream into the binding plate.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA in 50 uL of elution solution or nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Pool Eluates
steps.instruction: Pool the eluate from 6 extraction replicates of the same sample.

steps.title: Clean and Concentrate Sample
steps.instruction: Use a Zymo RNA Clean and Concentrator-5 kit to clean and concentrate the sample.

substeps.instruction: Elute the sample into a 30 uL final volume of nuclease-free water for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Prepare DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Combine the pooled eluate with TurboDNase and buffer.

steps.title: Incubate DNase Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 C for 30 minutes.
